councils.verifiedBy: claude-opus-5 (researched on behalf of Alayi MacPepple-Jaja)
councils.notes: Textbook made-versus-in-force gap: made 13 September 2016, in force 14 September 2017 — a full year apart. commencedOn is the in-force date, not the made date.

evidence.quote: There is an 'Article 4 direction' in place for Houses in Multiple Occupation (HMO) in York. The Article 4 Direction in relation to Houses in Multiple Occupation (HMO) removes 'permitted development rights' for this type of specified types of development and requires a planning application to be submitted to change a property from a dwelling house into an HMO.
